response.message: Settlers train one at a time
A Settler is already in training here
Dobrynya won't leave Vruchiy in the middle of a battle
The rally point is one of your own settlements
That slot is locked; upgrade the Elder's Hall
No horde comes against Novgorod to harass
Not while a battle is fought there
Its people need another standing village of yours to move to
